text:
fiona: Kicking off a phased rollout for release redwood-v2.2.3 in ~10m. Sequence: US -> EU -> APAC. Canary default 4%, 10m pin.

ryan: I'll run capacity + thermal sweep now and post results.

infra-bot: Preflight check starting...

infra-bot: Preflight results:
US: free GPUs 104/130 (80%), queues low
EU: free GPUs 58/78 (74%), queues low
APAC: free GPUs 20/48 (41%), queues moderate

sre-paul: APAC below 60% threshold. Options: warm-pool, lower APAC canary, or delay APAC. Recommend warm +3 nodes if possible.

maya: Warmpool +3 requested for APAC. ETA ~4m. If still <60% after warmup, propose APAC=1% canary and extended pin to 15m.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled by fiona. release=redwood-v2.2.3 regions=[us,eu,apac] canary=0.04 pin=10m. Use /deploy status 1745559999

fiona: Starting US canary now. /deploy start --release redwood-v2.2.3 --region us --canary 0.04 --pin 10m

deploy-bot: US canary started (slice s-511). Observability: https://console/redwood/obs/s-511

ryan: US metrics look fine. p95 +6ms, 500_rate unchanged, kv_cache_miss stable.

fiona: US pin complete and green. Proceeding to EU. /deploy start --release redwood-v2.2.3 --region eu --canary 0.04 --pin 10m

deploy-bot: EU canary started (s-512).

infra-bot: APAC warm-pool completed: free GPUs 28/51 (55%). Still under threshold.

maya: APAC still tight. Switching APAC canary to 1% and pin to 15m. /deploy update 1745559999 --region apac --canary 0.01 --pin 15m

deploy-bot: APAC config updated. Starting APAC canary (s-513) at 1%.

deploy-bot: :warning: APAC s-513 reports kv_cache_miss spike at +3m (1.1%) and 500s rising.

sre-paul: Tracing points to apac-backend-12: inconsistent shard map after a config push. Initiating rollback for s-513. /deploy rollback --slice s-513 --reason "shard map mismatch"

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. APAC pin released. Traffic reverted.

fiona: Holding APAC rollout. Action items: infra to resync shard maps and run staging smoke; maya to coordinate additional warm nodes for next window; ryan to prepare rollback checklist for next attempt. Opening incident INC-2026-199 and linking this thread.

maya: Created INC-2026-199 and attached logs + obs links. Will update when staging smoke is green.

fiona: Thanks all. US/EU live on v2.2.3. APAC blocked pending remediation. If anyone sees config drift elsewhere ping here. :thumbsup:
